# ChartForgeX browser renderer

This is the resolved output of `ChartForgeX.Interactivity.Html.HtmlDataChartAssets.Script` from [ChartForgeX source d9d66e0d](https://github.com/EvotecIT/ChartForgeX/commit/d9d66e0d4896b9a54478d66d7505d65c3ca3c260). It includes the native surface policy and palette. CanopyX loads it through the optional chart-renderer part.

The script is unmodified. Its SHA-256 is `F5EF10A90515F80B304E3C0474B56B6876E6E539E81AFEA95ED1D814F4A69D7C`. The upstream MIT license is included alongside it.
